Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in Katy, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rahter just give you the details of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, but I do need a name on the recording for our file. Please go ahead.
A: [Claimant name withheld] for the recording.
Q: Thank you. Can you describe where you were driving and which direction you were traveling when the collision
occurred?
A: I was heading east on the main road and approaching the intersection with a green light, or at least I believed it
was green. Traffic was moderate and it had been raining earlier, so the pavement was still wet.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I saw a car coming from the left side, but it was already partly in the intersection by the time I registered
it. I braked, but there wasn't time to avoid it.
Q: Where did the impact land on your vehicle?
A: On the driver's side, toward the front door. The airbag on my side deployed, and the whole car shifted sideways.
Q: How are you feeilng physically since the collision?
A: My right shoulder is hurting qiute a bit. I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and they told me to follow up
with an orthopedic doctor because it may be a tear. I'm also having some stiffness in my neck.
Q: Have you received any treatment since then?
A: I've had two physical therapy sessions and I'm scheduled for an MRI next week. I'm still having trouble lifting my
arm above my shoulder.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add or correct about your account?
A: Only that I was paying attention and I didn't contribute to what happened. I just want my car repaired and my
medical bills taken care of.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
